info.title: Solana API
info.description: API for generating Solana swap instructions across aggregated DEX liquidity.

get.description: Returns the list of enabled sources for the calling team.

parameters.name: 0x-api-key
parameters.description: Your API key from the [0x Dashboard](https://dashboard.0x.org).

parameters.name: 0x-api-key
parameters.description: Your API key from the [0x Dashboard](https://dashboard.0x.org).

is_signer.description: Whether the account must sign the transaction.

is_writable.description: Whether the instruction can change the account.

owner.description: Wallet that owns the associated token account.

oneOf.description: Address of an existing token account, or of a wallet for native SOL.
Wallet whose associated token account to use.

Destination.description:
A token account address (a wallet address for native SOL), or
{"associatedTokenAccount": {"owner": "<wallet>"}} to use that wallet's associated token account,
created if it does not exist. The sponsor pays the rent for a created account, or the taker when there is no sponsor.
The sponsor can close a created taker account once it is empty and get the rent back.
The rent for any other created account (a recipient, fee or trade surplus account) is not returned.

sources.description: List of enabled sources, as DEX labels.

FeeRecipients.description:
A comma-separated list of token account addresses, or a list in which each
entry is an address or {"associatedTokenAccount": {"owner": "<wallet>"}}.

accounts.description: Accounts the instruction uses, in order.

SwapInstructionsRequest.description: Request body for the swap-instructions endpoint.

amount_in.description: Amount of token_in to sell, in base units. For example, 1 USDC is 1000000.

disabled_sources.description: Sources not to route through. [Get Enabled Sources](/api-reference/solana-swap-api/sources/enabled-sources) lists the valid names; any other name is an error.

recipient.description: Where the bought tokens go. When omitted, they go to the taker's associated token account (the taker's wallet for native SOL).

reserve_transaction_accounts.description: Accounts to leave free in a v1 transaction for your own instructions. Ignored for v0.

reserve_transaction_bytes.description: Bytes to leave free in a v0 transaction for your own instructions. Ignored for v1.

slippage_bps.description: How far below amount_out the swap may settle, in basis points. 50 is 0.5%.

sponsor.description:
Address that pays the transaction fee and any account rent, so the taker pays nothing.
Must differ from the taker and from every address in the request that receives native SOL.
The taker still signs.

swap_fee_ppm.description:
Fees to charge on the swap, as a comma-separated list in parts per million of the trade. 10000 is 1%.
Each fee is at most 10% unless your app has a different limit.
Requires swap_fee_recipient with one entry per fee.
Fees on the same side apply one after another, each to what is left after the earlier ones. Each fee rounds up to a whole base unit.

swap_fee_recipient.description:
Where each fee goes, with one entry per fee in swap_fee_ppm.
In a sponsored swap, a wrapped SOL fee must go to an existing token account.

swap_fee_side.description:
Token each fee is taken in, as a comma-separated list with one entry per fee:
buy takes it from token_out, sell from token_in. When omitted, every fee is taken in token_out.

taker.description: Address of the wallet that sells token_in and signs the transaction.

token_in.description: Mint address of the token to sell. For native SOL instead of wrapped SOL, use So11111111111111111111111111111111111111111.

token_out.description: Mint address of the token to buy. For native SOL instead of wrapped SOL, use So11111111111111111111111111111111111111111.

trade_surplus_cap_ppm.description:
Most trade surplus to collect, in parts per million of the trade. Trade surplus is any output above amount_out.
Only used by apps that 0x has set up to collect their own trade surplus; for every other app,
0x collects it and this field is ignored. Requires trade_surplus_recipient.

trade_surplus_recipient.description:
Where the trade surplus goes. Only used by apps that 0x has set up to collect their own trade surplus.
Requires trade_surplus_cap_ppm.

transaction_version.description:
Transaction format to build.

- v1: up to 64 accounts and no address lookup tables.
- v0: up to 1,232 bytes; the response may include address lookup tables.

address_lookup_tables.description: Address lookup tables to pass when you compile a v0 transaction. Always empty for v1.

amount_out.description: Estimated amount of token_out received after fees, in base units.

instructions.description: Instructions to add to the transaction, in this order. Compute budget instructions are not included.

min_amount_out.description:
Smallest amount of token_out received after slippage and fees, in base units.
The transaction fails if the swap would return less.

route_plan.description: Legs of the route, in execution order.

sponsor.description:
The sponsor from the request, if one was given. Use it as the transaction's fee payer;
the sponsor and the taker both sign.

zid.description: ID of this request. Include it when you contact support.

SwapInstructionsRoutePlanStep.description: One swap leg in the swap route plan.

amount_in.description: Amount this leg sells, in base units.

amount_out.description: Estimated amount this leg buys, in base units.

dex_label.description: Name of the source, as listed by [Get Enabled Sources](/api-reference/solana-swap-api/sources/enabled-sources).

ppb.description: Share of this leg's token_in that earlier legs have not used, in parts per billion. 1000000000 is all of it.

token_in.description: Mint address of the token this leg sells.

token_out.description: Mint address of the token this leg buys.
